name: EPIC 211798652

text.card: A red giant 2,898 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.45 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,811 K at its surface.
